The migration is complete. All 10 batches (400 records) are now in the new CRM.

**Issue:** The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM prefixed them with +1. Of the first 120 records, 31 overseas customers have incorrect numbers, and batches 4–10 have the same problem. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

I did not change any phone numbers. I do not have the correct international numbers or the affected customer IDs.
